content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.pau.edu. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the PAU Research Associate-I and Young Professional-I posts is 21 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: For Research Associate-I, a B.Sc., M.Sc., or Ph.D. in relevant fields like Biotechnology, Plant Breeding, or Molecular Biology is required. For Young Professional-I, a Graduation in any discipline is sufficient.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 200/-. This fee needs to be submitted along with the application form as per the instructions.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate-I and Young Professional-I posts at PAU will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Research Associate-I is Rs. 67,000/- plus 16% HRA per month. For Young Professional-I, the fixed salary is Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for these positions. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any age-related information.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) at https://www.pau.edu.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational certificates, along with the filled application form.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies announced by PAU?
faq.answer: Punjab Agricultural University has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Research Associate-I and Young Professional-I under this recruitment drive.
